t: Triangular sander pad for surfaces, edges, and corners without jarring. Designed to be laid flat when sanding into a corner, rather than pressed on the point. Features a hook-and-loop-type fastening system for easy sheet changes. Extraction holes are designed for a dust-free and build-up-free high removal rate. Ideal for sanding down, conditioning and polishing wood, paint, varnish and fibre-reinforced composites. Compatible with all Starlock, Starlock Plus and Starlock Max power tools and common multi tools.
b: Starlock, Starlock Plus, Starlock Max Fitting & OIS
